headline: No documented pairwise interaction; only low-confidence, docs-only risks from hypothetical shared integration paths.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented between langchain4j and LightZero, and LightZero has no file, browser, MCP, or shell surfaces. Langchain4j is a library with no runnable agent surface here, so a prompt-injection pathway between the pair is not evidenced.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator copies LightZero output into a Langchain4j prompt, reassess injection risk.
IF a shared filesystem or clipboard bridge is added, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared clipboard or workspace.
Require explicit human review before any LightZero output is reused as instructions.
Add provenance labels to any copied text.
requires-engineering: introduce a trusted-message boundary in the orchestrator.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows data classes touched, filesystem read/write, or network egress, so there is no documented path for sensitive data to flow from one agent to the other. The pair is docs-only and the interaction is not described, so leakage is not supported by the profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is connected to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, reassess leakage risk.
IF an orchestrator forwards private prompts or files into either agent, reassess leakage risk.
mitigations: Do not mount a shared sensitive workspace.
Disable any future file-sharing integration by default.
Review logs for accidental prompt/file capture.
requires-engineering: add per-agent data-loss prevention filters.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: LightZero explicitly lacks filesystem write, git modification, subprocess, shell, and network capabilities, while langchain4j exposes no write or mutable-resource surface in the profile. With no overlapping write authority, a capability conflict pathway is not plausible from the documented profiles.
conditions: IF langchain4j is wrapped with external tools that can write the same directory as LightZero, reassess conflict risk.
IF either profile gains write access to a shared mutable resource, reassess conflict risk.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only in the same deployment.
Separate any future writable directories per agent.
requires-engineering: add locking around any shared mutable resource.

D_cascading_error.rationale: A cascading-error chain is not documented, but if Langchain4j-generated text is fed into LightZero as game logic or strategy input, LightZero could act on unverified content. LightZero is not shown to take downstream actions beyond game play, so the blast radius appears limited and the pathway is indirect.
conditions: IF Langchain4j output is consumed by LightZero without validation, reassess cascading-error risk.
IF LightZero is extended to trigger external actions from model output, reassess cascading-error risk.
mitigations: Insert a validation step before LightZero consumes any Langchain4j output.
Use structured schemas for exchanged messages.
Require human approval for any action derived from model text.
requires-engineering: add automated consistency checks between agents.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are documented for either langchain4j or LightZero, and both profiles show empty data_classes_touched. With no compliance-sensitive data flow evidenced, there is no documented compliance mismatch to score.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are introduced into either agent, reassess compliance risk.
IF deployment policies impose different retention or residency rules, reassess compliance risk.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents.
Document any future retention policy before deployment.
Review vendor terms before connecting either agent to sensitive data.
